notes: Class talents are skill rows with props.talent (type 21).
cooldownReductionPct is a flat CooldownReduction affix (usually 3% rank 1 / 6% rank 2).
reduceWeaponSkills / reduceNamedSkill are proc CDR from talent scripts, not a global haste stat.
affectedSkills come from texts.refs and reduceCooldown(Skill.Id) in scripts.
Live remaining CD still comes from Skill getters / onTriggerCD; this table is observation metadata.
